results.input: I don't get payslips. What should I use to explain my income?
results.reply:
As you're self-employed, start with existing business registration documents or recent invoices, rather than trying to produce employee payslips. Match the business records to the relevant receipts in your account so the source of earnings is clear. These are preparation suggestions; the actual documents still need checking.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk

results.input: Those deposits include transfers from my own other account. Is the whole amount my income?
results.reply:
No—the total deposits are not necessarily income. Moving the same money between your own accounts does not by itself create new earnings. Match the outgoing and incoming records and separately explain where the money originally came from. This does not establish that your funds are sufficient and is not a tax classification.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances
